title: C++: Data Pipeline
description: Build a data processing pipeline that passes data through a chain of transform functions.

steps.title: Pipeline
steps.description: Create a Pipeline class that stores a vector<function<int(int)>> transforms. Implement addTransform(fn) and execute(int input) that applies all transforms sequentially. Create transforms: double, increment, absolute. Test with input -3.
hints: Pipeline p; p.addTransform([](int x){ return x*2; });
execute applies each transform in order.
